title: Ordinary normalization of the framed relative cocycle
statement: Let T be a scheme, U an etale object, I an injective resolution of G [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and c a ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. For a frame (s,b) in the first short exact resolution row S [lem-amb-relative-cocycle-coordinates], project its raw relativeFrameClass to ordinary section homology, identify extension-by-zero homology with nonnegative section homology, and apply c.globalEquiv in degree one. The result is −δ_S(s), where δ_S:Z¹(I)(T)→H¹(T,G) is the ordinary connecting homomorphism. Consequently negating the raw relative class gives the ordinary lifting-torsor class.

proof.text: The concrete projection formula identifies the forgotten frame class with the homology class of the absolute section cycle whose inclusion is iCycles(s).

source.place: Tag 03AJ, lemma-torsors-h1; agent-written relative lifting-torsor refinement of its injective-resolution argument.

proof.text: Use the constant integer sheaf adjunction and evaluation on 1 to write s as a morphism g:ℤ_T→Z¹(I). Naturality of this adjunction shows that the absolute section cycle represents g followed by iCycles. Apply c.global_cocycle to identify its cohomology class with I.extMk(g≫iCycles).

source.place: Tag 03AJ, lemma-torsors-h1; agent-written relative lifting-torsor refinement of its injective-resolution argument.

proof.text: The Ext composition formula gives I.extMk(g≫iCycles)=g^*(I.extMk(iCycles)). By [lem-amb-first-resolution-extension-class] this is −g^*(S.extClass). The definition of the sheaf connecting homomorphism through H⁰ identifies the latter with −δ_S(s). Negation therefore corrects the ordinary torsor normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem relativeFrameClass_forget
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (U : T.Etale)
    {G : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}} (I : InjectiveResolution G)
    (c : ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison G I) (z : ResolutionFramedLift T U I) :
    c.globalEquiv 1
      (((((etaleSectionFunctor (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 T))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
        I.cocomplex).extendHomologyIso ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (rfl : (1 : ℤ) = 1)).hom
          (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (relativeForgetComplex T U I.cocomplex) 1
            (relativeFrameClass T U I z))) =
      -Sheaf.H.δ (resolutionLiftSequence_shortExact T I)
        (MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal @Etale T) z.1
